paite: Israel suante lak a pan na sanggampa Aaron leh atapate siampu hi a ka nna aseptheihna ding un la in. Aaron leh atapate: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar na la ding ahi.
heading: Siampute Puansilh / (Eks 39.1-7)

paite: Athupina ding leh akilawmna ding in na sanggampa Aaron a ding in puan siangthou bawl in.
Pilna kha a ka dimsak khutsiam tengteng kiang ah thu gen in, amau Aaron puan, amah hihsianna ding abawltheihna ding un. Huchi a ama'n siampu nasepna mun a ka nna aseptheihna ding in.

Apuan bawl ding uh hiaite ahi: Awmtuam, siampu puan, puanaktual, puanakzem, lukhu leh kawnggak. Na sanggampa Aaron a ding leh tapate a ding in puan siangthou abawl ding uh ahi, huchi a ama'n siampu nasepna mun a ka nna aseptheihna ding in.
Amau dangka-eng, adum, asandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih ala ding ua.
Dangka-eng, adum, asandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in hoihtak a bawl in, siampu puan abawl ding uhi.
Aliang nihte gei nihte akimat ding ua; akimatkhawm ding uhi.
Siampu puanakzem gakna, puanduang kawnggak dangka-eng khau toh khau dum, khau sandup leh khau san-au siamtak a gat puanmalngat in abawl ding uh ahi.
Onik suang nih na la dia, huaite tung ah Israel suante min na gelh ding ahi.
Suang khat tung ah aminte uh lak a guk, suang dang tung ah, a-omlaite min guk dangte, apiandan bang zel un na gelh ding ahi.

Suainamna zungbuh khuakthoh a kigelh bang in, suangmantam khuakthoh agelhsiamte gelh, huai suangmantam nihte ah Israel tapate min na gelh ding a, huai suangmantamte dangka-eng khuak sung ah na phum ding ahi.

Huai suang nihte Israel suante a ding a theihgigena suang hi ding in siampu puan liangzang ah na koih ding. Huchi in theihgigena ding in Aaron in aliangzang nihte tung ah TOUPA ma ah aminte uh apo ding hi.
Dangka-eng bulhna na bawl ding ahi.
Amongte a dangka-engtak khainiang nihte; pakkhi bang in na bawl dia, akibulhnate ah pakkhi bang khainiangte na khih ding ahi.
Vaihawmna omtuamna siamtak in na bawl dia; siampu puan bawl bang in na bawl ding, dangka-eng in, adum in, asandup in leh asan-au in leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in, na bawl ding ahi.
heading: Awmtuamna / (Eks 39.8-21)

paite: Khep nih in akikhep dia, akhep adung-avai kikim, khap khat a sau leh khap khat a za ahi ding ahi.
Huaite tung ah suang vual li in suangmantamte na bulh dia: avual khatna sardi suang, topaz suang leh karbankul suang ahi ding. Hiai avual khatna ahi ding hi.
Avual nihna emerald suang, sapphir suang leh diamond suang ahi ding ahi.
Avual thumna liguri suang, agate suang leh amethis suang ahi ding.
Avual lina beril suang, onik suang leh jasper suang ahi ding hi. Abulhna ua dangka- eng bulh ding ahi.
Suangte Israel suante min toh akithuah dia, amin uh dungzui in sawm-le-nih, chiamtehna gelhte bang in, michih amin toh nam sawm-le-nihte dungzui in ahi ding uhi.
Awmtuam tung ah pakkhi bang a bawl amongte ah dangka-eng siang khainiang na bawl ding ahi.
Awmtuam tung ah dangka-eng sikkual nih na bawl dia, huai sikkual nihte awmtuam mong nihte tung ah na koih ding hi.
Awmtuam mongte tung a om sikkual nihte ah dangka-eng pakkhi bang nihte na koih ding ahi.
Pakkhi bang khainiang nihte mong nih dangte bulhna nihte ah na khih dia, ama a siampu puan liangzangte ah na koih ding hi.
Dangka-eng in sikkual nih na bawl dia, huai gei a siampu puan mong nihte tung ah na koih ding; asunglam a siampu puan gei a om pen ah.
Dangka-eng in sikkual dang nihte na bawl dia, siampu puan gei nihte nuailam a atung ah na koih ding, amalam sang a akikhepna zawntak ah, siampu puan konggak lamdang tungtak ah.
Asikkual in awmtuam siampu puan sikkual ah puanduang dum toh na hen dia, huchi a siampu puan kawnggak lamdang tung a a-omtheihna ding in leh siampu puan a pan awmtuam akiphellouhna ding in.
Aaron in, TOUPA ma a theihgigena hiden ding a, mun siangthou a alut chiang in, alungtang zawntak ah vaihawmna awmtuam tung ah Israel suante minte apo ding hi.

Vaihawmna awmtuam ah Urim leh Thummim na koih ding. TOUPA ma a ava lut chiang in, Aaron lungtang zawn ah a-om ding hi. Huchi in Aaron in TOUPA ma ah alungtang zawntak ah Israel suante vaihawmna apo gige ding hi.
Siampu puan puanaktual adum in na bawl ding ahi.
heading: Siampu Kivatna Dangte / (Eks 39.22-31)

paite: Akhung ah a-awng a-om dia; alaitak a, a-awng kimvel ah gatthoh khihna a-om dia, siklen puanak ban nei lou hileh kilawm ahi ding, akeklouhna ding in.
Huai puanaktual mong ah adum in, asandup in leh asan-au in na bawl dia, agei kimvel in. Dangka-eng dakte akimvel in akikal zel uah na bawl ding ahi.
Dangka-eng dak leh theibuhfai puanaktual gei tung ah akivel in a-om ding ahi.
Aaron in nna asep chiang in huai asilh ding hi. Huchi in TOUPA ma a Mun Siangthou a alut chiang leh ahong pawt chiang in aging akiza dia, asi kei chih theihna ding in.
Dangka-engtak in kuang na bawl dia, atung ah na gelh ding, suainamna zungbuh bang a khuak in, TOUPA A DIA SIANTHOUNA chih na gelh ding ahi.
Huai laigelhna sikpek siampu dialkhip a, amailam ah khau dum in na khihbelh ding ahi.

Huai Aaron taltang ah a-om dia, ama'n Israelte thillat siangthou toh kisai a, Israel suante khelhna apo ding ahi. Huai Aaron taltang ah a-om gige dia, thillat siangthoute TOUPA mai ah san ahi ding hi.
Puanmalngat hoih puanak na gan dia, puanmalngat in lukhu na bawl dia, agatthoh in kawnggak na bawl ding hi.
Aaron tapate a ding in puanakte na bawl dia, kawnggakte na bawlsak ding. Athupina ding leh akilawmna ding in lukhute amau a ding in na bawl ding ahi.
Huaite na sanggampa Aaron tung ah leh akiang a atapate tung ah na koih dia; amaute thau na nilh dia, na septuam dia, na siansak ding ahi; siampu nasepna mun a ka nna aseptheihna ding un.
Avuaktanna uh khuh ding in puan pheituam zumte na bawlsak dia; atai a pan aphei chiang atun ding uh ahi.

Kihoupihna puanin a alut chiang un hiam ahihkeileh Mun Siangthou a nasem dia dohkan kiang a, ahong pai chiang un, khelhna khatpeuh neih ziak a asihlouhna ding un huaite asa tung uah a-om gige ding ahi. Huchi in huai amah a ding leh anung a asuante a ding in tangtawn a dan thuseh ahi ding hi.
